scripts.build: pnpm exec tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: pnpm run build && node --experimental-test-isolation=none --test packages/core/test/*.test.mjs packages/cli/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm run test && git diff --check && git diff --cached --check
